meta.title: MiniMax kit
meta.description: Installs the five MiniMax bundles as one Plugins entry: credit failover through a local proxy, the daily check-in chip and tool, model-list sync, the composer quota chip (minimax-coding-plan probe shares the credit endpoint), and MiniMax Code's skills and agents. Each part stays its own row, so you can still turn one off without the others. The three MiniMax Code MCP servers (rea, PhotoCraft, mcp-reverse) arrive off because rea alone adds 229 tools to every request.
